scope: Read-only ahead-of-stop original API identification; no new binding, emulation or success injection
binding_comparison_note: Live development snapshot only; another agent may add bindings later.
api_identification: Names inferred from matching wrapper ABI, checked enums/capabilities and actual application uses; not original exported symbol strings.
references_note: Official API signatures/capability names corroborate local instruction evidence. Mask APIs use OpenVG1.1 reference card page2; path bounds/length/interpolation page3.

APIs.name: vgRemovePathCapabilities
APIs.abi_note: r0..r3 hold first four words; remaining words are at entrySP+0,+4,...; scalar floating-point values use integer-register words in these original wrappers
APIs.evidence: Clears supplied bits from validated path object+20 with BIC; does not clear geometry.

APIs.name: vgGetParameterfv
APIs.abi_note: r0..r3 hold first four words; remaining words are at entrySP+0,+4,...; scalar floating-point values use integer-register words in these original wrappers
APIs.evidence: Text72a6dde queries paint color1a01/count4 into stack and reads floats. Wrapper dispatches by object type with float-output flag1.

APIs.name: vgAppendPath
APIs.abi_note: r0..r3 hold first four words; remaining words are at entrySP+0,+4,...; scalar floating-point values use integer-register words in these original wrappers
APIs.evidence: Checks source capability bit0/destination bit1, copies source segments and converts/appends coordinates to destination.

APIs.name: vgPathTransformedBounds
APIs.abi_note: r0..r3 hold first four words; remaining words are at entrySP+0,+4,...; scalar floating-point values use integer-register words in these original wrappers
APIs.evidence: Checks capability bit11, transforms four bounding-box corners with context path matrix, computes min/max and stores four floats.

APIs.name: vgMask
APIs.abi_note: r0..r3 hold first four words; remaining words are at entrySP+0,+4,...; scalar floating-point values use integer-register words in these original wrappers
APIs.evidence: Validates operation1500..1505 and positive width/height. Text calls mask0,operation1501 and rectangle while1130 MASKING is enabled.

APIs.name: vgRenderToMask
APIs.abi_note: r0..r3 hold first four words; remaining words are at entrySP+0,+4,...; scalar floating-point values use integer-register words in these original wrappers
APIs.evidence: Shares path draw core but passes mask-operation and distinct render-to-mask selector1; text uses paintModes2,operation1505.

APIs.name: vgPathBounds
APIs.abi_note: r0..r3 hold first four words; remaining words are at entrySP+0,+4,...; scalar floating-point values use integer-register words in these original wrappers
APIs.evidence: Checks capability bit10; stores original minX/minY and max-min without applying matrix; empty path yields zero origins and negative widths.

APIs.name: vgModifyPathCoords
APIs.abi_note: r0..r3 hold first four words; remaining words are at entrySP+0,+4,...; scalar floating-point values use integer-register words in these original wrappers
APIs.evidence: Checks capability bit2, segment-index/count and data alignment; replaces coordinates for existing segment range.

APIs.name: vgGetPathCapabilities
APIs.abi_note: r0..r3 hold first four words; remaining words are at entrySP+0,+4,...; scalar floating-point values use integer-register words in these original wrappers
APIs.evidence: Returns validated path object+20; invalid path reports1000 and returns0.

APIs.name: vgPathLength
APIs.abi_note: r0..r3 hold first four words; remaining words are at entrySP+0,+4,...; scalar floating-point values use integer-register words in these original wrappers
APIs.evidence: Checks capability bit7 and segment bounds, subtracts cumulative arc-length values; error return is float -1. Wrapper explicitly VMOVs result to r0.

APIs.name: vgInterpolatePath
APIs.abi_note: r0..r3 hold first four words; remaining words are at entrySP+0,+4,...; scalar floating-point values use integer-register words in these original wrappers
APIs.evidence: Validates three path handles and capabilities destination bit6/source bit5; fourth public word is read as float amount by lower routine.

conclusion: Prioritize actual text remove-capabilities and paint-float query; optional outline uses transformed bounds and masking. No direct postboot1 BL to path length or interpolation was found; do not spend runtime implementation effort on those solely because they are neighboring wrappers.
caution: Static paths are conditional, not a prediction that the next live frame will take them. Unknown APIs remain unsupported until their behavior is implemented and tested.
